name: lf11_11_disconnected
description: Conformance test 11. A zone that is not connected takes nothing (no put_in, supply unchanged) but still decays (10000 -> 9300); a zot 0x107A0000 goes to the first mask cell spiralling from the centre, here the centre (11, 21) itself, at (16x + 8, terrain + 3.0, 16z + 8); the zone counts for nothing in capacityTotal, usedTotal and SetGarbageCapacity. A second disconnected month keeps the one zot. Once connected, the next month removes the zot and the zone counts again (4 heaps x 67500). Zone 1, with its centre and the ring's first cell cleared, puts its zot on the next ring cell (31, 20) [choice: ring order clockwise from the top-left corner, spec question].
